definitions.gloss: to wander into; to stray into
definitions.explanation: to accidentally enter an unfamiliar place while lost or confused

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{迷|まよ}い{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I got lost and wandered into an unfamiliar alley.
A cat wandered into the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異世界|いせかい}→異世界：18438_isekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{迷|まよ}い{込|こ}んだような⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧になった。
examples.english: I felt like I had wandered into another world.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{迷|まよ}う→迷う：02426_mayou⟧ (to get lost, be confused) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to go into) → to go into while lost

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb - the subject wanders into somewhere.

RELATED ～{込|こ}む COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}む→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧ (to jump into)
- ⟦{投|な}げ{込|こ}む→投げ込む：17605_nagekomu⟧ (to throw into)
- ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧ (to rush into)
- ⟦{入|はい}り{込|こ}む→入り込む：04629_hairikomu⟧ (to enter, get into)

USAGE:
Implies accidental or unintentional entry, often with a sense of being lost or confused.
